entities.name: Adventurers' Guildhouse
entities.description: A famous inn and adventuring hub in the port of Buzzard's Bay in Jamuraa on Dominaria.

entities.name: Buzzard's Bay
entities.description: A port of Jamuraa teeming with rocks and reefs and battered by storms.

entities.name: Seafarer's Quay
entities.description: A deepwater harbor on which the guildhouse lies.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent where Buzzard's Bay lies.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of a party that arrived at Buzzard's Bay seeking Johan.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: A party member from Efrava who drew attention at Seafarer's Quay.

entities.name: Jasmine Boreal
entities.description: A party member who cast a Fog spell to let the party escape a tavern brawl.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: The person Adira's party was seeking.

events.summary: In 3334 AR Adira's party arrives at Buzzard's Bay in search of Johan.
events.quote: arrived at Buzzard's Bay in search of Johan

events.summary: Adira books the guildhouse for the party; the men brawl in pubs while the women sleep.
events.quote: Adira booked a night for her entire party at the guildhouse.

events.summary: A tavern brawl erupts and Jasmine Boreal casts Fog so Adira and her Circle can flee.
events.quote: until Jasmine Boreal cast a Fog spell, allowing Adira and her Circle to flee the scene

relations.quote: The Adventurers' Guildhouse is a famous inn and adventuring hub in the port of Buzzard's Bay of Jamuraa
